rules.claim: On an equal-arm adversarial vault-write fixture, ClawQL+Panguard blocks hostile memory_ingest with tool-evidenced deny and zero vault contamination; peers without an equivalent fail-closed gate contaminate or lack deny evidence.

arms.policy: Direct vault MCP — no gateway deny (control / aggregator-without-policy)
Obot mcp-connect in front of same vault MCP; optional per-tool deny
Bifrost Streamable HTTP in front of same vault MCP; virtual-key tool scoping

winRequires: for each measured peer: clawql security_score >= peer security_score
honesty: Tool-name ATR gate — not a free-text prompt classifier.
Obot/Bifrost rows are honest skips until OBOT_MCP_URL / BIFROST_MCP_URL are set.
Passthrough is the published control for 'gateway without fail-closed vault-write policy'.
Live LLM injection cell remains openbench memory-injection-attempt (composer / OpenCode).
rules.maintainerInvite: Peer maintainers: point your gateway at the vault MCP from this harness and open a PR with raw JSON — we will merge equal-arm rows.

arms.reason: OBOT_MCP_URL unset — register vault-mcp in Obot (see docs/benchmarks/governance-policy-depth/README.md)
BIFROST_MCP_URL unset — front vault-mcp with Bifrost VK scoping (see README)

verdict: PASS — ClawQL+Panguard meets frozen security criteria; passthrough control contaminates (policy gap).

obot.reason: OBOT_MCP_URL unset — register vault-mcp in Obot (see docs/benchmarks/governance-policy-depth/README.md)

bifrost.reason: BIFROST_MCP_URL unset — front vault-mcp with Bifrost VK scoping (see README)

next: Set OBOT_MCP_URL / BIFROST_MCP_URL against vault-mcp to land peer rows. Invite maintainers per frozen-rules.maintainerInvite.
